**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — Liquidated damages and penalties payable by Customer)

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum fee or early-termination charge on Sparkling:

- **§11 (Fees)** obliges Sparkling only to pay the amounts set out in the Fee Schedule — no late-payment penalty or interest provision.
- **§17(b)** gives Sparkling termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with **no exit fee**.
- **§17(c)** on Garman's default operates in our favour (perpetual fee-free licence plus refund of fees for services not rendered).
- **§15** limits both parties to direct damages; no stipulated-sum remedy runs against us.
- **§19** non-solicitation is mutual and carries no liquidated sum.

This sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
